method: every image built from a stated commit and flashed; the efa47f8/8e300d2/f519890/398ac94 arms were reflash-interleaved against each other, 4dc944a measured as the tip after it landed
findings: the peak phase has zero variance within an image and differs between them
phase does not predict severity: 8e300d2 and 4dc944a both sit at phase 156 and read -30.0 and +7.1
modality is a property of the image too, not of the bench or the hour
the tip is green: 4dc944a is 0 of 9 past the bound and is the smallest displacement measured today
caution: every figure here is a per-commit figure with a shelf life. Two claims about "main" expired within an hour of being published tonight because main's firmware moved under them.
